name: 06105 · Hartford, CT
findings: ZIP 06105 (Hartford) has 160 nonprofit organizations. 87 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (12% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06105 (Hartford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06105 (Hartford) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 73 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
